scope: Northstar draft 146547245140; changes are confined to demo/sample-computer-store-20261007

findings.evidence: Components returned a 404. Shopify showed published to 0 channels despite two products being present.
findings.resolution: Selected all eleven Northstar collections and included them in Online Store only. Components then rendered its two products.

findings.evidence: Light active-tab text on a default white tab background; FAQ content used light text on default white.
findings.resolution: Completed tab, active, divider, panel and accordion color settings in both native product templates.

findings.area: Blog, article, collection and slider palettes
findings.evidence: Template settings supplied dark backgrounds but omitted individual text colors, leaving schema defaults such as #111111.
findings.resolution: Set explicit text, muted text, input, card, tag and button colors using the Northstar palette.

findings.reproduction: Use adjacent paragraphs in a product description. The excerpt concatenates the last word of one paragraph with the first of the next.
findings.cause: strip_html removes paragraph boundaries without inserting whitespace.
findings.resolution: Normalize paragraph, list-item and line-break boundaries before stripping HTML.

findings.reproduction: Set dark surface and light text colors. Filter fieldsets remain translucent white, weakening contrast.
findings.cause: Hard-coded rgba(255,255,255,0.55) background ignores configured surface color.

findings.reproduction: At the observed desktop width, the collection select consumes available flex width and squeezes Sort into two lines. The 404 search input similarly squeezes its button.
findings.resolution: Give labels and action buttons non-shrinking flex bases; allow the select to use remaining space.

findings.evidence: A redundant purchase block repeats sold-out controls. Computer-case content uses system-oriented labels. Shared recently-viewed history can show unrelated demos.
findings.resolution: Removed redundant purchase and shared recently-viewed sections; relabeled specifications and compatibility; added a native split-content planning section.

findings.evidence: Document titles, logo labels and footer copyright used shared shop.name: Quadratum Theme.
findings.resolution: Added optional storefront_brand_name setting with shop.name fallback; set Northstar Systems for this draft.

findings.evidence: Navigating from the Northstar product to the support URL displayed OpenPath Living's preview bar and layout. Explicit preview_theme_id=146547245140 restored Northstar.
findings.resolution: Use explicit Northstar preview URLs when entering the draft. Concurrent previews in one browser can compete for the shared storefront preview session.
findings.status: platform/workflow limitation; no other demo modified

findings.evidence: Wide campaign images cropped the tower at the edge of half-width panels; support offered booking and phone actions that were not connected.
findings.resolution: Use the supplied product compositions in split banners, reduce supporting banner height and route support actions to real contact and guide pages.

findings.evidence: Shopify import rejected the section because stylesheet was nested inside conditionals, which then prevented product templates from importing.
findings.resolution: Moved stylesheet outside the conditionals. Shopify import succeeded before this review.

findings.evidence: Browser computed colors show text inputs inherit dark global backgrounds while select and textarea keep section hard-coded white backgrounds.
findings.resolution: Added one scoped input-background setting and computed matching foreground for all text controls. Northstar uses Graphite.

findings.evidence: The above-posts tag block stacked five pills vertically in a full-width panel.
findings.resolution: Use a wrapping flex list so topic navigation fits its available width.

findings.evidence: Unsupported lucide/name values resolved to missing assets and displayed the black worm fallback on the dark homepage.
findings.resolution: Use four existing Quadratum SVG icons as flat, deployed theme assets, colored Polaris for this demo.

findings.evidence: Browser rendered /quadratum-theme.myshopify.com/cdn/... because URL normalization collapsed the leading // from asset_url into /. All valid icon assets then failed.
findings.resolution: Preserve Shopify asset_url output; remove destructive slash normalization.

findings.evidence: Screen reader names stayed Learn more because a nonempty default aria_label overrode the visible label. Four templates also contained unsupported spacing settings.
findings.resolution: Remove the generic ARIA default, explicitly match Northstar button names, remove unsupported settings and reduce mobile banner minimum height.

findings.evidence: Cards and footer linked #orders, #warranty, #returns and #access, but actual accordion IDs were section-prefixed.
findings.resolution: Add an optional short-anchor mode to the native tabs/accordion section and enable it for Northstar Support. Preserve prefixed IDs by default. Route Browse answers directly to Orders.

remaining_limits: Search uses the shared store catalog.
Demo inventory remains zero and checkout is not offered.
No external booking provider is connected.
Fixes have not been merged into Quadratum main or other demo branches.

validation.result: No document-level horizontal overflow in these routes. Screenshots and pointer events timed out during this session; full mobile interaction and visual validation remains outstanding.
